prompt: What is the reference angle for $300^\circ$? Give just the number of degrees.
hint: $300^\circ$ is in Quadrant IV, closing in on a full turn.

hints.text: $300^\circ$ is in Quadrant IV, closing in on a full turn.
In Quadrant IV the reference angle is $360^\circ$ minus the angle.

explanation: $300^\circ$ falls between $270^\circ$ and $360^\circ$, so it is in Quadrant IV.
The nearest part of the $x$-axis is the $360^\circ$ (same as $0^\circ$) direction.

alternativeExplanations.title: How far from home
steps: Ask how much more rotation would bring you back to the starting ray.
From $300^\circ$ you need another $60^\circ$, so the terminal side sits $60^\circ$ below the positive $x$-axis.
